glosses: To throw a pitch at a much slower than expected speed.

examples.text: He changed up on Wilson after three fastballs and struck him out.

glosses: To confuse someone by doing something unexpected or in an unexpected way.

examples.text: I thought that we were going to study the project some more, but then he came back from the weekend and changed up, making it a top priority.

The more accessories you have (cheaper than clothing and can be worn multiple times) it's easier to change up your look. So, imagine having one dress that you can accessorise 4 different ways, simply with a shoe change […]
